t:
Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.
r98242.n: Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her…

t:
Events that year began with a distress signal received from the Imperial research ship, the Infinity. It was sent by Cosmos to study the deep layers of the astral plane. After summoning the Hero of Sarnaut, Cosmos asked him to find out what happened.

As it turned out, the Infinity discovered one of the Seals of Nihaz and was exposed to darkness that killed the entire crew. It turned out that Nihaz managed to create a new subspecies of demons - demons of Darkness who can influence the very Spark of creatures.

These demons were about to become a serious threat to Sarnaut, but then Zayan proposed a plan: to create an army of undead that would not possess the Sparks and therefore would be immune to such influences. At Catherina's suggestion, Foul Dale on Umoir was chosen as the gathering place for this army. And Klavdia Kalugina proposed to strike with this army at Nihaz and whatever he hides behind this Seal.

To create the army of the undead, a talented warlock was needed - it was Dakkar de Desirae. In addition, one of Urd's scrolls was discovered in Dale. Urd was an ancient Xadaganian summoner who possessed knowledge that greatly aided the creation of such an army. In addition, they managed to conclude an alliance with vampires, exiles from the House de Doucer, and subdue the ghosts of Gipat.

On Gipat, Dakkar and the Hero of Sarnaut found a very important testimony about the past of Nihaz and Klavdia Kalugina: "One day a very eloquent Traveler visited the court of the Mother and Father. The traveler confused many people, and Klavdia's sister was one of them. Those events started the Great War."

So far, it was difficult to interpret this data. After putting heroes of the past (Danas, Naira, Fergard, Reniesta, and Gorislav Averchenko) at the head of the army of undead generals, Dakkar and Nyan were able to restore Annette de Tristesse's mind - a vampire who also joined their army, becoming the commander of all vampires.

They also needed to get the Key to the Seal. It was obtained with Klavdia's help: she took the Hero of Sarnaut to the island Heart of Fire where the dragons kept the Key of Chaos. They got the key, but it turned out that Agrus and the other dragons were building an army of Draconids. They intended to attack the League and Empire in the near future.

After the army of the undead was ready, they were loaded aboard the Eclipse which headed for the Seal. The resistance of the demons and Nihaz's servants was enormous, but none of them stood a chance against the undead who simply swept away all the barriers. The only problem for Sarnaut's heroes was Hedus-Avior-Mirach, the Void Dragon, torn apart by Nihaz and distorted by darkness. While the commanders were planning another attack, it gave everyone a brief respite.
r98244.n: Events that year began with a distress signal received from the…

t:
The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.

Kyros was stopped at the last possible moment, when he was already fighting the Servant. Altered by darkness, the immortal Aoidos vanished.

After these events, the other Dominus handed over power over the Well of Souls to Klavdia, Zayan, and Catherina. They created their own Orders of Followers.

Soon a new Dominus appeared from the Well of Souls - Cosmos. He decided to hold Dionic Games. During the games, Cosmos showed everyone that Nihaz was ready to retaliate. Apparently, Nihaz was behind the Wanderer who helped Kyros.

Cosmos used the Observatory, a unique creation that had its own mind, to send the hero of Sarnaut first to the past, where he saved Skulnar the Fierce, and then to the future, where the hero managed to bring the Sculptor to the present right before the world was destroyed by Nihaz. Later the Sculptor became the chief Architect for all architects in Sarnaut.

Cosmos announced that Nihaz was ready to destroy Sarnaut - and the only chance for the League and Empire to unite, ending all wars. If the leaders of states refused to do this, then Cosmos threatened to erase them from history with the help of the Observatory. That was when the League and Empire signed a peace treaty.
r98247.n: Ask about the events on Ammer

t:
The forebodings turned out to be true. Soon Umoir was struck by a mysterious Leper that turned all living beings into corrupted creatures, and once thriving groves and meadows into gloomy wastelands. Later was discovered the demonic nature of the Leper, created by Queen Catherina, whose will had been enslaved by Sarn.

The spread of the Leper was barely stopped with the help of Klavdia, who appeared out of nowhere. Catherina hastily fit out a huge ship called Eclipse and rushed to the depths of the Astral to find and destroy one of the Seals keeping Sarn confined. The greatest heroes pursued her and battled Sarn with the power of incarnated Nezeb and Skrakan - the Great Mages of the past. Catherina was released from the deleterious power of the God of Light. Then the Sarn's Avatar, which was hiding in the Ancient Mound, was destroyed, and the history of Leper on Umoir was finally put to an end.

Still the enormous power that Klavdia had stolen from Tep bothered the Great Mages of the League and the Empire. It was clear that it was nearly as great as that of the Gods. But what could Klavdia do with it? And where had Tep found a source of divine power? If it is not located, the next strike can be lethal for Sarnaut...

Though no one expected it, the demonic threat is back. The renegade imperial mage Gorluxor, who has joined the neutral faction of the Historians, has made an attempt to claim the Gift of Tensess. Demon cultists and the demons themselves came to the Holy Land with him. It was a miracle we managed to stop them. Gorluxor was killed in the Tensess Temple, seemingly for the last time, with no chance of resurrection.

"The Great Astral Campaign is not over! The demonic threat has not been eradicated. You started celebrating too soon! The enemy is hiding and preparing to strike again," said Tensess's Soul to the heads of the state.

After seeing the evidence of the return of the demons, the League and the Empire realized that their old enemy was by no means defeated. On the contrary, he had been planning another attack for years. And while many allods were saved this time, the world still remained in mortal danger. The demons and their cultists needed to be defeated before they destroyed Sarnaut.

Realizing that the League and the Empire alone cannot hope to defeat their common enemy, the Veterans of the Great Astral Campaign united in secret, creating the "United Army", an alliance of the Empire and the League.

There was also the City of Demons. The League and the Empire kept trying to get there, but it wasn't easy. Something unexpected was waiting for the heroes in battle against Gorluxor. He wasn't alone - the room he was standing in was filled with capsules. And each capsule had Gorluxor in it. He himself had also changed considerably - from under the hem of his mantle, tentacles were visible instead of human legs. Behind him stood a strange apparatus - a device that allowed the cultists to come to life without the Gift of Tensess.

But after that device was destroyed, something amazing happened - Gorluxor's Tower shook and moved. It's like it disappeared into the ground. Alarmed, the heroes stepped closer to the pit.

As they descended into the Abyss, the heroes met a strange old man who looked more comical than threatening. And when the heroes defeated him, something incredible happened - the old man split into two parts - one was unthinkably beautiful, and the other was disgustingly terrible. A beautiful angel and a disgusting spider, so big that it filled the entire Abyss with its body. It was a hard-won victory, but it was still unclear who was behind Gorluxor.
r98253.n: Learn about the events in the Holy Land and their consequences

t:
Tep, an Arisen from the Zem people, found a way to live forever by killing his own compatriots with a deadly plague and absorbing the power of their Sparks. The mightiest sorcerers joined their forces to repel the aggression of the Summoner and contaminated Tep with his own plague. Confined in his own Pyramid and sustained by his Sparks, the Summoner was doomed to thousands of years of dying and resurrecting again... His own genius condemned him to madness.

But several millennia later Tep Cultists found a way to release their master...
By studying the past we can shape our future. That is why my work is so important. By helping me to uncover the world's mysteries, you are helping the Empire!
Ugh, I don't feel so good.

The ogres are very dangerous. It won't be easy to lure them into a trap. For bait you should use the meat of wild boars. They live all over this allod so they should be easy to find.
After you gather a lot of meat you should throw it into a cage. The ogres should eventually be unable to resist the food and enter the trap.
And what makes you think I'll give you that? As if I were just going to sign some papers all of a sudden. Hmph... I thought the citizens of the Empire had a higher opinion of us.
r98529.n: And what makes you think I'll give you that? As if I were just going…

t: Oh I see. Okay... Hm, the seal isn't broken... Good. Here's another package for you. Bring it to Vera Chonkina. Be quick about it and make sure you don't look inside!
Got it. Let's see what Pravdin wants from me... Wow! I didn't expect something like that. Well, I guess it's necessary. Here's your new package. Please bring it to Pavel Bogdanov.
Hello. Are you looking for me?

Yes, I know who you are talking about. We've captured some bandits recently, they tried to sneak into the Citadel. They called themselves Treasure Seekers. We reduced them to dust.
I doubt that anyone else would risk their lives trying to repeat their mistake.
Those who violate the Master's law will be slain!

t:
"In the battle of gods that took place in another world, one god was defeated by another. The first one was Sarn, the God of Light. Nihaz, God of Darkness, had to find the way to imprison his enemy, as gods are immortal. He decided to create a new world for the vanquished God of Light..."
These words open Tka-Rik's Revelation. Our world is a prison. Now you have to pass the first trial prepared by Nihaz. Repeat his deed and put Sarn back in chains. To do so, you must use the powers of the Magic Chain five times. Crystal Barrier granted by my armor will help you to resist the God of Light.
Shall we start the first trial? When you're ready, touch these three spheres to obtain special abilities for the forthcoming battle!
r99877.n: I'm ready to learn the first part of the Revelation!

t:
Here is the next part of the Tka-Rik's Revelation:
"As long as this world exists, Sarn cannot break loose. Nihaz summoned dragons, the magical beings, to protect Sarnaut. Twelve Dragon Keepers controlled twelve parts of the world. They were the most powerful creatures, their very existence ensured that the prisoner would remain confined.
The planet created by the God of Darkness was barely habitable - only dragons capable of withstanding the extreme cold and heat could live there. They were devoted to their task for millions years, until a huge meteorite collided with Sarnaut. It destroyed a large part of the world, killing three Guardians. Shackles holding Sarn became looser..."
Wait! I feel a hostile presence... There's someone else in here... It can't be a demon, they don't get that far... A cultist?
Will you help me to kill him? Touch the sphere to obtain a special ability to destroy the Crystal Barrier! Hurry up!
r99880.n: I'm ready to learn the second part of the Revelation!

t:
I'm sorry, the plan has changed...
My people found a way to return me to life. You are going to playing your part in it, by the way, and so are the Dragons. It's hard to believe - sworn enemies have united to challenge the god!
I will no longer obey the orders of this betrayer who turned my people into the miserable underground beasts! Damn you Nihaz!
I'm going to disappear in a moment. Prepare yourself, as the protective spell that holds the demons will fall. It's an ultimate test for you! Do your best to survive.
Farewell. If it works, we'll never meet again. And remember - don't trust anyone! Neither Sarn, nor Nihaz. Everybody lies, especially gods...
r99886.n: I'm sorry, the plan has changed... My people found a way to return me…

We destroyed the biggest gangs ten years ago, with your help, but some petty bandits are left. We're hunting them down. We'd finish them, but the war is always in our way. You know, the demons, the architects...

Over the last year, the bandits have been receiving help from outside the allod. Someone brings smuggled weapons, puts in stashes on the shore, and quietly leaves. We don't have enough ships to patrol the whole place.

I'll set up a great manhunt after the Great Ball. The new gang, the Rats, are a pain in merchants' neck. I need to chase the rats down and execute them.

Siveria is slowly being populated, mainly by Gibberlings, but Kanian saltworkers, hunters, and woodcutters, also come here.

The nobility has been visiting us over the last year. They're plotting something. Mark my words.

I'll be happy to visit a big city and the Great Ball. I hear, they are going to grant amnesty to House de Doucer. I can't wait to see.

These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

What? Are you going to interrogate me? Do you want me to reveal the secrets of our command?
Well, listen to me! Yasker has no secrets! He is a Great Mage, a disciple of Nezeb himself, hallowed be his name! Yasker is perfect! Do you understand? I doubt that. Your Tensess can't even be compared with our leader.
This is over. I won't tell you anything!

Stop! Calm down! Stop the violence!
What do you want to know? A Yasker's weak spot?
Hmm... Perhaps I'm the only one who can tell you something about that.
For a very long time I've been trying to understand why Yasker hates us, the Zem people. He keeps this secret safe, but I found the answer on an occasion. During my final exams one young necromancer demonstrated his abilities, and I saw how the Great Mage was trying to avoid the summoned creatures! You see?
He hates undead, their rotten flesh, their smell... And his disgust spreads on us, too!
What a fool! Why can't he see the difference? He's got to change his attitude, or soon he will be dethroned.

Allright, I'll do you a favor, only thanks to your previous services. Here is your new standard. Make sure not to lose it.

t: I understand your concerns. No, I haven't seen the people you describe. I doubt they are that brave or that stupid to approach the Citadel after they refused to follow the Master's law.

Greetings, Seeker of Truth. I see doubt in your eyes.
What bothers you?

The Ashes of the Past! The Time would prefer to devour this magic substance over you. Every time you travel to the Past, you have to feed Time with this delicacy.
You can find the Ashes of the Past on an Isle called the Astral Graveyard.

In the middle of the Crossroads there is a Whirlpool of Time - a vortex where the Past that came to be, the unstable Present, and the variable Future are swirling.
The Whirlpool of Time is dangerous. An unexperienced time traveler would rather drown themselves than appear in the right place at the right time. But don't worry - I will teach you everything you need to know.
Still, we require something else but your bravery and my powers. Time is always hungry for blood, but we can deceive it.
r106764.n: Ask about travels into the Past

t:
You see, a certain event occurred about a century ago that put at risk all our current attempts to withstand both demons and the Power that controls them. If we change the Past, our present lives will be so much easier!
Besides, we'd better deliver a strike when our enemy least expects it. Sarn is not prepared now. I think this is a great opportunity!
r106765.n: Ask about the need to change the Past

t:
The main change you triggered is that the great battle between the League and the Empire has ceased to be! The Expeditionary Corps and The Regiment of Kirah never engaged into the bloodshed, they came prepared for the demon assault.
Of course, demons pummeled both armies, but not as severely as they used to.
As a result, demons had to change their tactics. But more on that later...
Your actions had other consequences as well. Yasker, for one, became terrified of zombies and decided to study necromancy deeper. So we are not sure of the outcome of his battle against Eniel.
On the other hand, having witnessed the resurrection, Negus Tot did not put much trust in science and confided in religion instead. Nobody knows yet what it means for us.

As you may guess, we shall not lay our arms down. There is something we should change in the Past. It is no less important than the prevention of war or the salvation of Kirah. We will do it, and no assassins will stop us!
The mysterious demon you encountered was an assassin whose only goal was killing you. Our enemy knows that we want to change the Past, and he made his move.
r106768.n: Ask about the threats from the Future

t:
Now you must understand everything. Eniel is on mission from Tensess to retrieve the Dragon's Heart, while Yasker is trying to keep it, fulfilling Nezeb's will. And I want you to outsmart them both.
No, I'm not a Great Mage, and I need the Dragon's Heart for reasons other than immortality... I'm not much interested in one, you know.
This is what I wanted to tell you. Much of your knowledge about this world is based on lies. Trust me, and you will learn the truth.

All candidates in the Conclave had to drink this blood as the last step of their trial. Dragon's blood flows in the veins of each Great Mage. They have to renew it regularly, but finding a Great Dragon is no small feat nowadays. And of course, dragons hate Great Mages. Soliskar the Wise had to make sure there are no Great Mages among Demon Hunters before forging an alliance with them. She will never befriend Historians, for example. Did you happen to bring a strange potion to Zayan de Desirae, back when he fought vampires? Well it was the vial of the Dragon's Blood.

All right, I shouldn't keep you in the dark any longer. The treasure is a heart of a Great Dragon killed thousands years ago by June people. You know, Great Dragons are immortal by nature. It seems Junes went to a great length to kill one. And even now, long after his death, the Heart of a Great Dragon is bleeding.
This blood holds the secrects of the immortality of the Great Mages.

Vlad is a guardian of the most important Nezeb's treasure hidden on Kirah. Of course he isn't a Great Mage! Nezeb would have never trusted his treasure to one!
To be honest, the League is here not for Meteoric Iron either. Tensess was looking for the treasure, too. Now you know the secret that only Yasker and Eniel were aware of.

If you have read the chronicles of the past, you might remember what they say about demon intrusion to Kirah. Let me cite it for you...
"First fell the tower of Vlad, the Great Xadaganian Mage..."
Can you see any towers here?
There is none. Vlad is here, but no tower around. Why? Because Vlad has never been a Great Mage!
r106773.n: Ask about the Mystery of the Mages

t:
You can still call me Gorislav, as you used to. Or if you wish, call me Director.
As for my true name... The answer will come in time. The Time will call my name!
r106774.n: You can still call me Gorislav, as you used to. Or if you wish, call…

t:
Runes can be removed from one item and sold or inserted into a different item. To do this, you'll need to buy a special removal pick that I can sell you. However, you must remember that every time you remove a rune, it becomes weaker. There's also a small chance that it'll be completely ruined.
I recommend obtaining a more advanced removal pick or grabbing some Rune Removal Seals from the Allods Boutique to safely remove runes. It's a small price to pay to protect such a valuable item.
Runes of a single type and level can be combined to create a more powerful rune of that same type. To do this, you'll need to buy a special welder, gold dust, and crystal chips. You can buy the welder and the gold dust from me. Crystal chips can be obtained in the Allods Boutique, auction house, or by trading with other players.
Runes must inserted into special slots. Keep in mind that not every piece of equipment has slots. However, you can always make a slot yourself with the help of an engraving kit. You can also make existing slots bigger with an engraving kit. You can find various different types of engraving kits in the Allods Boutique as well.

Good question! Know that the rune not activated can be sold at Auction House. But as soon as you use its powers, the rune becomes bound to you.
Don't forget it when you combine the runes. If at least one bound rune is used in the combining, the resulting rune will bind to you too!

r107106.n: Exchange 3 Rune Removal Seals for 24 Crystal Chips.

r107110.n: Exchange 3 Mithril Engraving Kits for 48 Crystal Chips.

r107114.n: Exchange 3 Steel Engraving Kits for 24 Crystal Chips.

r107118.n: Exchange 3 Adamantite Engraving Kits for 96 Crystal Chips.

r107122.n: Exchange Improved Rune Removal Pick for 2400 Crystal Chips.

r107126.n: Exchange Professional Rune Removal Pick for 4200 Crystal Chips.

t: Exchange all old instrument for chips
r107127.n: Ask about exchanging old rune tools for crystal chips.

t:
Lately we discovered an interesting thing in the journals of our ancestors. They knew more about Crystal Chips than we could possibly imagine!

For example, you can employ an alchemical technique to transform chips into... just about anything! Of course, we immediately thought of the goods in the Boutique. All that for just a handful of chips!

There’s only one problem – we need to build a special mechanism. And magic tech is beyond us, so... Perhaps you can help us? We have the schematic – you just need to build it!

Oh, wow! Just like the schematic! Well, that makes sense...

Now we need to make this thingamabob work! I’m sure you can figure this out, too. I mean, what if it explodes...

Make sure to tell us everything when you’re done!
We are the masters of runes. We know everything there is to know about them and we'd be delighted to share this knowledge with you!
r107132.n: We are the masters of runes. We know everything there is to know about…

t:
Ah, so you're here about the rune!
Yes, I do have one for you. Here, take this. Thanks for the delivery!
r107199.n: Ah, so you're here about the rune! Yes, I do have one for you. Here,…

t: I report: situation critical! I'm running out of cards! And my volunteers leave all the time! I need more, now!
r107383.n: Ask if any help in organizing the celebration is needed.

t: Has Vsemil sent you? That's right on time.
r107384.n: Has Vsemil sent you? That's right on time.

t:
What? Five silver? Hm... Okay!
I don't know why I stole that book. The Astral controlled me, I swear! I just saw it lying on a bench and I took it, I had no idea... I'll be glad to get rid of it!
r107392.n: Offer five silver coins for the book

t: What? I know nothing, I've seen nothing, I've heard nothing, I've taken nothing! I'm not nervous! Not suspicious! I know no books! Oops... I shouldn't have said that!
r107393.n: What? I know nothing, I've seen nothing, I've heard nothing, I've…

t: Vsemil thinks it's funny? I'm starving here! I ain't gonna do anything until he sends some food!
r107398.n: Ask if any help in organizing the celebration is needed.

t: Demon damn it, exactly what I've been hiding from!
r107492.n: Demon damn it, exactly what I've been hiding from!

t: Code Green, rose-two-six. Another skunk tried to steal a card!
r107529.n: Code Green, rose-two-six. Another skunk tried to steal a card!

t:
Ah, so is that why you came? Yes, I replaced Nezeb's Staff with a fake, and those stupid scientists couldn't even tell the difference!
You ask who put me up to this? Only the Light! The true guidance that only faith in Tensess can bring!
The Light showed me the darkness of the state, and all of the bribery and corruption in it! Yet the officials turn a blind eye to it all, and do anything necessary to get ahead. Sooner or later this darkness WILL be dispelled, and then the evil defilers of the Empire will be cast down.
Soon, we will flee this corrupted land. The League will not leave us in our time of need, and their ships should be landing on the shores of the Empire any minute. We will return to Kania and gather our strength until the Empire can be defeated!

This thing...? This is just a piece of wood. You can throw it into the fire for all I care.
What really matters is kindness. I recently had a revelation and realized that the Empire has forgotten about mercy and goodness. The Kanians should be our brothers, but our soldiers kill them and the scientists use the defenseless prisoners in their experiments.
I had to put an end to this. And not simply with words, but with steel and fire!

Ah, so is that why you came? Yes, I replaced Nezeb's Staff with a fake, and those stupid scientists couldn't even tell the difference!
You ask who put me up to this? Only the Light! The true guidance that only faith in Tensess can bring!
The Light showed me the darkness of the state, and all of the bribery and corruption in it! Yet the officials turn a blind eye to it all, and do anything necessary to get ahead. Sooner or later this darkness WILL be dispelled, and then the evil defilers of the Empire will be cast down.
Soon, we will flee this corrupted land. The League will not leave us in our time of need, and their ships should be landing on the shores of the Empire any minute. We will return to Kania and gather our strength until the Empire can be defeated!

Nonsense! That's just an old wives' story! This is all because of Boko the Fierce. He was an Orcish Prospector that earned his living by trading artifacts, but then he vanished into thin air! We all thought he was dead, but then I heard that he was spotted in Nezebgrad. He bought an Astral ship and a ton of other things at the auction house. He really threw his money about.
I assume he made a fortune off a rare artifact somehow.
r108297.n: Ask them about the Wish Maker

t: Hello. Do you want to talk about something?
r108298.n: Hello. Do you want to talk about something?

r108562.n: Are you sure you want to bind to this location?

t: You can bind to this location for returning here later.
These ruins can transport you in a number of locations.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
r108568.n: These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

t:
With the frequency I get asked about this question, I should write the story down on a piece of paper and hang it above the entrance to the Inn... Well, listen up because I'm not going to repeat this.
There was a Prospector named Boko the Fierce who lived here not long ago. He found out about this legend and wanted to find this "Wish Maker" and make his dearest wish come true. He found another three idiots and together they went searching. No one has heard from his companions ever since.
I bet he killed his three companions and stole their belongings. That's how he could afford to go back to Nezebgrad and buy a ton of things. I'm sure it was dirty money. What a bastard.
r108874.n: Ask them about the Wish Maker

t: Ah, peanuts! Your Spark goes to me and remains forever in my box. Have you ever lost?

We're not playing riddles. That's Simargl's thing.

We're going to play hide-and-seek! All three Sparks are currently here, in the Holy Land.

You can find the Spark of Ath-Zak's beloved one, Luja-Gialla, on Eljune. His teacher and Great Mage Tka-Rik's Spark is in the lands of Asee-Teph. His own Spark is somewhere arounds on the Plateau. Find them in this order without any hints or someone else's help, and consider yourself a victor.

Oh, wait, wait a minute. What challenge are you talking about? We're too adult for that kind of stuff. As custom has it, why don't we make a bet? A simple one. Without room for cheating. I'll be generous. You can have not only Ath-Zak's Spark, but also the Sparks of his girlfriend Luja-Gialla and the June Great Mage Tka-Rik. If you can complete the trials, of course.
r108877.n: I challenged you more than once! That's what I'm going to do now!

t: Well. Why do you care about his pleas? Oh, right, I keep forgetting. Well, let's talk since you're here anyway.
r108878.n: Osip's ghost came to me and demanded that I return Ath-Zak's freedom!

t: Do you have a question for me? Don't hesitate to ask! I'll gladly give you an answer!
r108879.n: Do you have a question for me? Don't hesitate to ask! I'll gladly give…

t: Why have you come back here?
r108880.n: Why have you come back here?

t:
Argh! You're all the same! How many times do I have to say that I know nothing about it? Yes, Boko belonged to my clan! Yes, he became fabulously rich and bought a whole allod, but I have no idea where he got the money! I don't want to hear anything about him!
That Boko disgraced my clan! He was nothing but a mean bastard! I'm sure that whatever he did to get that money, it wasn't legal. I would advise you not to follow in his footsteps.
r109391.n: Ask them about the Wish Maker

t: What do you want? Speak quickly, I'm busy!
r109392.n: What do you want? Speak quickly, I'm busy!

t:
Damnit! Why did I allow Boko to talk me into this in the first place?
Now I'll be cursed forever!
r109404.n: Listen to what the Spirit has to say

t:
I am nobody... Hah! I am nobody!
I am just a shadow in the night!
I am forever dead... Thank Tep!
r109410.n: Listen to what the Spirit has to say

t: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit, trapped by Tep's magis, seems to be trying to tell you something.
r109411.n: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit,…

t:
I am not going to give up!
Argh! If only I could get out of here! I'd teach that Beak a lesson not to betray friends!
r109419.n: Listen to what the Spirit has to say

t: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit, trapped by Tep's magis, seems to be trying to tell you something.
r109420.n: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit,…

t: Where are the others? Lost? Hehe, whoever finds it is in for a surprise!
These magpies are trained to pick up loot and bring it to you. Very useful for a busy adventurer! You can buy one in the Boutique.
The southern tomb can wave the curse
r109488.n: The southern tomb can wave the curse

t:
Hm...
I've heard this legend before. Tep's ancient and powerful artifact that can grant any wish. Maybe it's true, maybe it isn't.
One thing I know for sure is that nothing good can come from Tep! He was the reason my people perished!
Care for a piece of advice? Stay out of it. You will regret it later, but it will be too late.
r109513.n: Ask them about the Wish Maker

t: Do you want to be part of nature? Alright, here you go. For you, it's free.
r109515.n: What are these clothes made of leaves?

t:
We're trading with other tribes.

Such as Lizardmen. They're weird. They can't take a joke. They don't buy clothes made of leaves. And they've got scales! They hate arctic raspberries. But they love fish.

And then there's goblins. They aren't good persons. Always trying to cheat.

Others are even worse. They have just enough brains not to eat one another.

If it weren't for the port, trade would be much worse.

Human talks. Water flows. Bird flies. The sales are up!

We get all sorts here, asking around about the Forestfolks. Historians!

One of your crowd visited recently. A girl. She was writing something down in her book. Books are good, better than birch bark.

She bought our blowguns and arrows. Arrows are good, too. One arrow like these can kill a troll.
That's right, put these strange ideas out of your head and focus on finding the real descendant of the Legendary Orc.
Oh please, you are no psionicist. You're just a weird shaman.

What? You?!

No, it has nothing to do with you. We are looking for a descendant of the Legendary Orc who could wield one of the types of higher magic - elemental, necromancy, and so forth...
r110377.n: I think I'm the one you are looking for.

t:
By fulfilling my tasks, you will learn more about the area, see its beauty, and help the inhabitants of this region. Once you complete all my tasks, you will be given a valuable reward.
However, lately we've been getting complaints that our tasks are not easy to complete. Well, we are willing to assist you. You can buy symbols of this area and valuable resources from me - that will complete two of my tasks and financially support the Institute of Local History.
Choose the road you wish to take.
r110378.n: By fulfilling my tasks, you will learn more about the area, see its…

t:
You gotta understand - there are no orc psionicists... And you... you're just a weird shaman.

Just keep your mouth shut, or you'll get hauled off to a mental hospital one of these days.
r110457.n: Why does no one believe me?

t:
All right. Just don't get anxious. It happens!

It's stress and hot weather - it's cooking your brain, hah.

Uh... Hang on... wait here. I'm going to call the doctor.

Just stay calm. They can fix you!
r110459.n: The thing is, I'm... an orc psionicist!

t: Believe what? If you're having... some kind of issue, you should go to the medical unit, it's to the south of here.
Cool. I’ve got job for you, and it’s not about flowers.
Helping is good, it’s always welcome.
Not now. I’ll need sturdy guys with brooms tomorrow morning. I need to clean up a lot.
r110568.n: Ask if any help in organizing the celebration is needed.

t: How come you can't see him? He's right there. Squint your eyes, bow your head, wink... See him now?
It's not easy to handle this one!
The final fight is the toughest one!
Looks like this time we'll have to save the world by ourselves. Unless you decide to flee, of course. In that case I'll make it alone!
r111294.n: Ask Marianna if she has found any assistants.

t: Yes, I've found an alternative option... However, touching it gives me the creeps.
Yes, the Wand is ripe. It is glowing... With darkness. I've seen a lot, but this stuff makes my skin crawl.
r111296.n: Ask if the Wand is ready

t: So much effort! Finally, we'll find out whatever he has predicted!
r111300.n: Ask about the End of the World

t: Just don't pass out. It's not exactly an optimistic picture.

What?! That's the only prototype! Where am I going to get another one?
Consider yourself lucky that, while some keep losing unique devices, others find them. Here it is. And see that you don't drop it again!
r111350.n: Ask for a new Semiotic Restorer

t: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
r111351.n: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

t: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
r111352.n: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

t: Hey, what the hell! What kind of help is it? One assistant is clumsier than the other! One carries bits of astralium in his pockets and then complains about some outgrowth. Another one tried to use the seventh page of the Great Mage's Diary to kindle a fire. The third... May he rest in peace... Argh! I've found the translator, here it is. Don't lose it again!
r111353.n: Ask for a new Versatile Translator

t: Looks like the world needs saving once again... You with me?
r111354.n: Looks like the world needs saving once again... You with me?

t:
Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Yasker, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the Empire from Timur Kefirin, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the League players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Yasker himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.

r112205.n: Яскер читает праздничную речь каждый час в 45 минут, не опаздывай!

r112537.n: Я хочу отметиться как участник праздника!

t:
Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Aidenus, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the League from Silantiy Vinegarov, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the Imperial players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Aidenus himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.

Now, if you wanna help, here's the list of those who you must invite to the party.

First, it's Fith the Forester, a Blue Corporal from Igsh Military District. He's a real man, always ready to fight! Can't even remember when I last saw him without bruises on his face...

Second, it's Shildar the Wily, a Red Captain... you got me, right? That's gonna be some show, right? Don't tell anyone, though. I don't want the joke to be spoiled.

And third, it's Marianna Preminina, IMD Commissar. Real headstrong woman with an iron fist! But I can tell everyone will be glad to see her here.

All clear? To the rear! March!
r113483.n: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

t:
Is that meat? Looks disgusting. And stinks, too. Let me have some... What are you staring at? My bro once tried to eat an Astral demon. Imagine, how hungry he was! It's a pity he couldn't. The demon fell into ashes!

Listen up now. The lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him.

As soon as he's calm, not too sleepy, not too annoyed - it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you have it done.
We're having a party here! Don't go too far from here.

Of course. Here's a list of guests for you.

First, it's Timofey Gromov, a distinguished druid. He might look gloomy and thoughtful, but he is a true druid, very skillful. Kanians and Gibberlings adore his magic of Nature. Who knows, may be we have a chance to see a miracle...

Second, it's Pakhom Rogov, construction council agent. He's not very widely known, but he's pretty, so the ladies here are going to love him. We're making up a legend for him now, you know, for the ladies.

The third and the last one is Vladimir Zalesky, the League commander. A real hero, a legend for kids, he's got a few stories to tell, for sure.

Do you have any questions? No? Then I'm hoping to see all the guests here soon!
r113529.n: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

t:
You have brought the meat? Excellent. Hm, looks good enough... I think.

Now, our lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him, like a baby. As soon as he's calm, it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you've finished.
Flowers, and tapestry, and musicians! Just imagine, how beautiful it all will be!
Do not forget to congratulate Aidenus!
I've got the best goods for adventurers!
r119202.n: I've got the best goods for adventurers!

t: Sing and dance, dance and sing!
I have only the best goods!
I have only the best goods!
New loot from the graves! Just kidding, don't worry!
r119296.n: New loot from the graves! Just kidding, don't worry!

t: Happy Intercession day! Let the Light bestow its blessings upon thee!
Take your pick. Today I've got special items for all Scouts!
I have only the best goods!
Take a rest from battle, feast and make merry! With Swordring!
I have special goods for alchemists today!
Congratulations, merry blacksmith! Now, what item is to your liking?
Best goods from the best tailors!
r119384.n: Best goods from the best tailors!

t: Congratulations, merry weaponsmith! Now, which item is to your liking?

Oh! A Prophetic Card is a rare and valuable item.

If you are lucky enough, even one card might reward you generously. Why, of course! You can't toy with destiny!

It's not that simple, though. The card will not reveal its secrets by itself. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards.

Your chance of winning the grand prize increases with each attempt. Go for it, and may the odds be ever in your favor.

Hm... Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot help you. This is not a good moment to toy with fate.

I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.
Sorry, you don't have enough money.
Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!
r130716.n: Spend 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin and complete all daily quests again!

t: Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!
r130732.n: Spend 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin and complete all daily quests again!

t: Here's my advice: when you hop into his arms, give him a hug and a languish sigh... and he's all yours!
r130853.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: What would I advise? Meet a new lady with caution! Should you try to go straight ahead, she may give you a slap.
r130867.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: What would I advise? Do not ever argue with him. Let him think he's the one to rule. But remember that it's not you who wants to be held, it's him who wants to hold you in his arms! You just have the kindness to assent!
r130886.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: Ladies should be treated with a gentle hand! We are delicate creatures, with frail bodies and hearts...
r130887.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: My advice is quite simple. When you're in somebody's arms, keep quiet and don't start a dispute. Otherwise there's always a risk of finding yourself on the ground!
r130891.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: A gallant chevalier will stand by his only soul mate and never do her harm. Remember that ladies are jealous, and they have sharp claws!
r130892.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: Seeking for advice? Well, here it is. When your sweetheart is near, don't ever utter a coarse or slangy word. Be a lady! A boy will never fall in love with a rude girl!
r130923.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: Seeking for advice? Oh, here it is. Don't be intrusive! If a lady doesn't feel like jumping into your arms, do not persist, or she may take you for a rude fellow!
r130924.n: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: Don't forget to congratulate Yasker! You'll see, he'll be happy!

Citizens of the Empire! Today we celebrate the birthday of a person without whom there would be no Empire! The great leader, who led the Empire to prosperity and united under his rule the proud Xadaganians, the powerful Orcs, and the Arisen, to create a great nation! A person who personally fought against the demons during the Night of Astral Portals, and emerged victorious!
So we congratulate our constant leader, the Great Yasker with all our hearts, and wish him eternal health!
And you, if you like, can acquire some souvenirs of the holiday and some gifts from me.
Remember the history of your state and be proud of it!
r130997.n: Remember the history of your state and be proud of it!

t:
Ugra-Xada is a very old word... Not many Xadaganians remember why their favorite holiday is called so.
Thousands years ago, before our world was shattered, the Great Nezeb left Kania, a state that was immersed in sin and vice. He met proud and honest nomadic tribe in the southern steppes. These skilled horsemen and fearless warriors called themselves the people of Ugra. They believed they were descendants of an ancient god Ugra. When Nezeb defeated their leader in an honest fight, nomads believed that he was god. The great Xadaganian state was born that day.
I'm offering special holiday items to Xadaganians during the celebration.

Opening of the Eyes and Lips was a burying ritual among the ancient Zem when the deceased person was symbolically reborn for the afterlife. The ritual gave the name to the day when the Arisen celebrate their return to life. Don't expect to hear the thunder of salutes and drunken shouting: the Arisen don't like wild celebrations much. Meditations, reflections and discussions about science and future of mankind are more to their liking. On that day, however, even they can't help but pamper themselves with wonderful holiday souvenirs!

t: Remember your history and take pride in it, citizen!

Sabantuy is a traditional orcish holiday. In the olden times, when the orcs were wild and led a nomadic life in the vast steppes, only once a year all the orcish tribes would gather for a celebration. Mighty fighters would compete in crushing rocks with their bare hands, drinking up barrels of beer on a wager, and hammering each other on the head until only the toughest orc with the strongest forehead would remain on his feet. The winner would earn a war club as a reward, as well as the respect of the tribe. A lot has changed since. The orcs have become esteemed citizens of the Empire, but the tradition of celebrating Sabantuy remains.
When the holiday rolls around, the orcs still drink beer by the bucket, hammer each other on the head with ritual clubs, make lots of noise and fun, and, of course, play their favorite game, goblinball. Besides, any orc that visits an artisan during the celebration can become a lucky owner of valuable gifts and souvenirs.
Hello! If you want to learn about Imperial holidays, I'll be glad to tell you! If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.
Seeking for advice? Well, here it is. When your sweetheart is near, don't ever utter a coarse or slangy word. Be a lady! A boy will never fall in love with a rude girl!

Pretty green, but there's visible enthusiasm already. In our business it's a must.

I guess Vranomir didn't say much when he sent you here, right?

Well, let's start with the basics. You are probably familiar with the canons of the Church of Light. How Nezeb and Skrakan sacrificed their lives to close the demonic portal to another world, so the demonic threat was eliminated. Doubting this dogma is tantamount to heresy and treason, but you and I are outcasts anyway, right?

Listen to me very carefully: it seems that the demons weren't completely defeated! How so? I'm not sure, but there's an alarming level of activity on Asee-Teph. They are clearly planning something...

And no one can stop them but us.

You need to be ready. While you're getting settled here, complete the tasks of your commanders and wait. When you are certain you are well prepared, find me and let me know.

So they teleported behind the wall. Then they walked - quite a bit. And in the end I saw mountains, somewhere in the north-east - not far from the Astral shore - and Portal ruins. So this is how they get here! They couldn't cross the mountains, so they found an old June Portal and repaired it somehow!

Well, my eyes could have failed me - making prophecies is hard; it's like looking into murky waters. You should go and see for yourself if I was right. Maybe they took our sorceress somewhere through that Portal...

Is it so? Ah, I don't like looking into the past - makes my head hurt too much!

Wait, let me concentrate...

...

I can see! Some people... And something big... and evil... There are charms on it, so I can't see it clearly, but I can feel its aura... They are screaming... Eladia looks back... Flash of light - three of them fall down... Oh god... They killed Eladia!

...

Ah, no... She's alive. But I can't see her Thread... What is this? A Portal? They carry her by the arms... And they're carrying what's left of the monster....

...

I can't do this anymore!

Your destiny is to be a Weaver, therefore your choice will be decisive.

Fate prevails over everyone, even gods and demiurges. The All-Mother is also subject to its unstoppable power. Who knows what's in store?
